description:
Move one node so its bounds face sits against another node's, lining up the other axes: modules edge to edge, storeys stacked. Saves the scene and verifies the gap.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/place-adjacent"}

alignOtherAxes.description: How to line up the other two axes: min, center, max or none (keep). One mode for both, or per axis, e.g. {y: 'min', z: 'max'} for same base height and one front plane.

axis.description: Axis along which the two pieces meet (x, y or z of the chosen space).

gap.description: Distance between the two faces along axis. 0 = flush; negative = overlap (inset).

reference.description: Node that stays put: exact node path relative to the scene root, e.g. './Facade/Wall_01'.

scenePath.description: Exact scene to read or change, e.g. 'res://levels/street.tscn'. It must be open in the editor (any tab).

side.description: max: subject goes on the reference's +axis side (its min face against the reference's max face). min: the -axis side.

space.description: world: world axes. local: the reference's own axes, for a rotated facade.

subject.description: Node to move: exact node path relative to the scene root, e.g. './Facade/Wall_01'.

name: summer_place_adjacent
title: Place a node against another
